sources.note: Brief specifies mm dimensions and N*m torque; use mm and N, so 40 N*m = 40000 N*mm.
Envelope 160 mm along x, 80 mm along y (up), 80 mm along z; origin at minimum corner.
Steel is stated; assume isotropic linear elasticity with E=210000 N/mm^2 and Poisson ratio 0.3 because grade and elastic constants are unspecified.
Brief specifies volume fraction 0.3; tool applies it to non-passive design volume.
Brief specifies 2 mm elements; h=2 mm.
x=0 end bolted rigidly to gearbox; fix x,y,z translations over full x- face.
16x16 mm footprint flush y=80 gives center (y,z)=(72,40). Opposing lug center y=8 gives 64 mm couple arm. F=40*1000/64=625 N along +z for +x right-hand torque.
16x16 mm footprint flush y=0 gives center (y,z)=(8,40). Equal opposite force -625 N along z yields zero resultant and +40000 N*mm about x.
Top lug footprint is stated; assume a solid pad one 2 mm element deep, x=158..160, y=64..80, z=32..48, to retain the load interface.
Bottom lug footprint is stated; assume a solid pad one 2 mm element deep, x=158..160, y=0..16, z=32..48, to retain the load interface.

passive.note: Preserve the 16 x 16 mm top drive lug footprint; assume 2 mm axial thickness (one element).
Preserve the 16 x 16 mm bottom drive lug footprint; assume 2 mm axial thickness (one element).

spec.description: 160 mm x 80 mm x 80 mm shaft bracket; y up. Fully fixed gearbox interface at x=0. At x=160, 16 x 16 mm top and bottom drive lugs centered at z=40 carry a pure +x torque of 40 N m: +625 N along z on the top lug and -625 N along z on the bottom lug (64 mm centroid separation). Assume isotropic steel E=210000 N/mm^2, nu=0.3 and 2 mm axial depth for solid drive lug pads.
